subject: PO header mapping + weekly remit lane & early-pay incentive
messages:
From: Kailash Rao <kailash.rao@aureus-sys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Fernandez <maya.fernandez@aureus-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO header requirements and weekly remit lane request

Hi Jordan / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Aureus is excited to move forward. Our procurement team is starting contract intake and we hit a couple of billing constraints on our side that I wanted to raise early so we can align before legal redlines. High level:

- Aureus requires a PO template with the following header fields to be present on every invoice: PO_ID, Cost_Center, Remit_To_Account, GL_Code, and Contract_Entity.
- Our AP team prefers weekly invoicing (Friday cut, payment run the following Tuesday) for certain usage-based services; we can provide a weekly lockbox routing and remit instructions.
- Standard Aureus terms are Net30, but we can accept Net45 if an early-pay incentive is available (we typically negotiate a 1–2% early-pay discount for faster processing).

I attached our PO template to this thread. Can Redwood confirm: (a) you can stamp our PO headers on invoices, (b) accept weekly invoice cadence for the RDW-87712 engagement, and (c) whether you could offer an early-pay discount (specify % and trigger window)?

If it's helpful, we can do a 20-minute call with procurement + AP to walk the mapping. Targeting contract signature by the end of June.

Best,
Kailash Rao
Senior Procurement Manager — Aureus Systems
[Attachment: Aureus_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kailash Rao <kailash.rao@aureus-sys.com>, Maya Fernandez <maya.fernandez@aureus-sys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header requirements and weekly remit lane request

Hi Kailash — thanks for the clear note and the template. We can accommodate most of this but want to surface a few constraints and a proposal so procurement and AP can sign off quickly.

Quick summary: we can accept weekly invoices and map the requested PO header fields into our billing system, provided the PO_ID is present on every invoice line and the remit account is a validated lockbox. Our standard hosted contract is Net45; to bridge to Net30 we can offer an early-pay incentive. Proposed optional trade:

- Option A (preferred for Aureus): Net30 with 1.75% early-pay discount if payment posts within 10 days of invoice date.
- Option B (better for Redwood cashflow): Net45 with a 2.25% discount for payment within 7 days.

Operational asks to implement weekly remit lane:
- Please confirm the exact field names in your PO export (we can adapt key names but need consistent keys).
- Send one sample signed PO or the PO export format for a test invoice before go-live.
- Provide the lockbox routing and remit account with a point of contact for AP (we'll whitelist the account).

I've attached a short payment matrix (internal use) that shows the margin impact for the two options. Vanessa / Ben — can you review and confirm whether Option A is acceptable from a discount/finance standpoint?

Kailash/Maya — if you can do a 20-minute working session tomorrow (Wed) at 10am PT we can validate the field mapping and finalize the amendment language.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_proposed_payment_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aureus PO mapping + discount sanity check

Jordan — thanks for the note. Quick internal check:

- Ben: can finance support Option A (Net30 + 1.75% early-pay for day-10 posting) without eroding our margin targets for RDW-87712? If not, state the preferred floor.
- We will need legal to add a 1-page amendment to the SOW specifying weekly invoice cadence, the required PO fields, and the lockbox remit instructions. Procurement will want PO_ID immutability for reconciliation.
- Ops: we'll whitelist Aureus lockbox once we get the remit acct and a test invoice. Also confirm whether we can accept PO_ID in either numeric or alphanumeric formats (some customers send prefixed IDs).

Ben — please reply with the discount impact and whether treasury needs a minimum allowed discount (e.g., 1.0% floor). If this looks good I'll coordinate with Legal and loop in AP ops for the mapping call.

— Vanessa
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Kailash Rao <kailash.rao@aureus-sys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Fernandez <maya.fernandez@aureus-sys.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header requirements and weekly remit lane request

Jordan / Vanessa,

Thanks — we can move forward on Option A (Net30 + early-pay incentive) provided Redwood confirms the 1.75% figure and the trigger window (payment must clear bank within 10 calendar days). Aureus will update the PO template to ensure PO_ID is in the header and will send a sample signed PO by EOD today.

Operational confirmations from Aureus:
- Weekly invoice cadence accepted (Friday close / Tuesday remit).
- Lockbox routing and remit account will be shared in a secure DocSend link (we prefer not to put account numbers in email).
- We will accept alphanumeric PO_IDs (prefix allowed) and will include Cost_Center and GL_Code fields.

We'll plan to join the 20-minute mapping call tomorrow at 10am PT. Please confirm the calendar invite and whether Redwood needs any additional onboarding fields (entity tax ID, billing contact).

Best,
Kailash Rao
Senior Procurement Manager — Aureus Systems
[Attachment: Aureus_PO_Sample_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]
